recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current source satisfies FHIR-36165 after later work-group refinements, and changing the element back toward the original Jira comment XML would conflict with subsequent accepted decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-36165 was a Published/Persuasive R5 Imaging Integration change request asking that ImagingSelection include a category element in addition to code, with usage modeled on Observation.category and Observation.code.
initial_application: Commit 1891df8e49d773c1958178726f7399e5f5bd7e7e ("imaging CR FHIR-36165, FHIR-36164, FHIR-36120") added ImagingSelection.category to source/imagingselection/structuredefinition-ImagingSelection.xml. The applied source used 0..* cardinality, consistent with the Observation-style category pattern, despite the Jira comment XML showing max 1.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists imagingselection as an active resource in the II work group. Later final category-family decisions keep and refine the element: FHIR-36786 rejected removal, FHIR-37405 updated the category terminology binding, FHIR-43114 added the category search parameter, FHIR-48095 and FHIR-48097 refined the definition and made the binding preferred, FHIR-47966 changed the related code binding after THO work, and FHIR-54827 aligned the code/category example text with current bindings.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current StructureDefinition defines ImagingSelection.category as a 0..* CodeableConcept summary element with definition "Classifies the general purpose of the imaging selection." and a preferred binding; the narrative has a code/category usage section and the search-parameter bundle includes ImagingSelection-category.
